leadText: Pokémon Adventures: Best Enemies is the thirty-fourth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters thirty-two, thirty-three, and thirty-four of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

Pokémon Adventures: Best Enemies is the thirty-fourth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters thirty-two, thirty-three, and thirty-four of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 72 - Weezing Winks Out
Chapter 73 - Valiant Venomoth!
Chapter 74 - Make Way for Magikarp

==Important events==
Koga and defeat Agatha.
Sabrina and battle Lorelei after being frozen on the arms by her dolls of the duo.
Sabrina defeats one of Lorelei's Pokémon.
Lt. Surge and are challenged to a battle by Bruno.
and Blaine catch up to Lt. Surge and Bill, but are blocked.
